description: Screen every rated market against hard constraints and return a VERDICT FOR EVERY MARKET IN SCOPE, not only the ones that pass. Use when the decision has firm limits (a cost ceiling, a required commercial operation date, a minimum tier, a minimum carbon score) rather than a weighting preference. Complements pgiq_best: pgiq_best ranks by lens, pgiq_screen decides. Read `summary` for the one-sentence answer, `results` for the qualifying set, and `rejected` and `insufficient_evidence` for everything that did not pass -- a failing market is REPORTED with its decisive reason, never silently dropped. CRITICAL DISTINCTION you must preserve: `does_not_qualify` means we measured it and it is outside the limit; `insufficient_evidence` means NO RECORD EXISTS and the market was never tested. Never report the second as a rejection or as evidence the market is unsuitable. `required_mw` is RECORDED BUT NOT TESTED -- no verdict confirms a market can physically serve the load, and you must reproduce that caveat when reporting a shortlist. Verdicts and decisive reasons are free at every tier; only the precise observed figures need a paid key (set PGIQ_KEY).Cost figures are for the standard case: a 100 MW load at 95% load factor on high-voltage (transmission-level) service, US dollars per MWh, delivered (not wholesale). Responses from API schema 1.1 onward also carry figures.{field} = {value, unit, as_of (ISO date or month), source, method, confidence, stable_id, report_url}: when present, quote the unit and as_of from it, and a null value there carries figures.{field}.absence -- insufficient_evidence (not enough evidence), structurally_unavailable (does not exist there, e.g. no wholesale market), not_collected (exists, not held) or withheld (paid) -- with reason_text; report which one. Older responses have no figures object: take the unit from the field name or field_provenance and the date from as_of. Either way, never report an absent value as zero; say it is not held.

max_cost.description: Maximum delivered recurring cost for the standard case, USD/MWh (100 MW, 95% load factor, HV), excluding customer-funded connection capital.

min_carbon.description: Minimum carbon pillar score, 0-100 (higher is cleaner).

min_evidence_depth.description: Minimum evidence depth: M1, M2, M3 or M4.

min_tier.description: Only markets at this tier or better (1=best, 5=worst).

required_mw.description: Load size in MW. Recorded but not tested.

target_cod.description: Required commercial operation date: a year (2030) or an ISO date, as the user said it.

name: pgiq_screen
